text:
maya: Heads up — ran into an odd failure on canary. Client stream stalled when upstream was slow, edge hedged after ~1.2s, both upstreams sent overlapping token ranges and client got duplicate partial tokens then truncation. Anyone seen this?

tom: yup saw that earlier in canary-18. Hedging + client backpressure created overlapping outputs. :grimacing:

arjun: do we have an explicit stream-offset in proxy↔upstream protocol today? I thought we only had resume_token for full response resumes.

maya: Correct — resume_token exists but it expects a full checkpoint. Thinking we should add a lightweight per-stream offset so the proxy can dedupe chunks when hedges arrive.

sara: Important: how does this interact with rate-limiter charging? We currently charge tokens on send to upstream, so hedged requests may double-charge.

tom: Alternative: provisional reservation model — second hedge acquires provisional tokens which become final on the first successful deliver, otherwise reclaimed. Might be heavy to implement.

maya: MVP idea: (a) emit X-Edge-Stream-Offset (token-index) in the first data frame from upstream, (b) proxy tracks last-delivered token-index per client and drops overlapping frames, (c) add metric hedged_overlap_count. Keep billing change for follow-up.

arjun: small nit: 'token-index' requires a tokenizer reference (models differ). Upstream should also emit X-Edge-Model-Family so offsets are interpretable.

sara: could we use generation-step counts instead of raw token ids? simpler to reason about across models in same family.

dena: Implementation question — how do we carry offsets over HTTP/2/QUIC stream frames? header only at start isn't sufficient for midstream switches.

maya: proposal: first DATA frame must include a JSON prelude if X-Edge-Stream-Offset header not present, e.g.: 

```
{ "start_token_index": 1234, "model_family": "llama-v2" }
```

Proxy parses that and stores per-upstream stream offset.

tom: And dedupe rule: if incoming chunk's token_index <= proxy.last_delivered_index => drop. Otherwise deliver from (last_delivered_index+1).

arjun: Edge case: partial token boundaries — token_index granularity might still cut in middle of grapheme. We should document that offsets are logical generation steps, not byte offsets.

sara: Ops/metrics: add hedged_overlap_count, provisional_tokens_reclaimed, dedupe_drop_ratio. Trace tags: hedged_upstream_id, start_index, delivered_index.

maya: TL;DR: MVP = token-index start + dedupe + metrics. Leave provisional token accounting and billing changes to a second phase. I'll draft a short RFC with header/frame schema and a small state machine diagram.

dena: :thumbsup: start with low-risk MVP and iterate.

arjun: sgtm. I'll hack up an h2 frame-extension POC and share by EOD.
